methodology.prDetection: Compares your latest section time against all previous efforts to detect personal records.
methodology.sectionTrend: Tracks median performance on frequently visited sections over time.
methodology.periodComparison: Compares training metrics so far this week against the same point last week.
methodology.hrvDescription: The 7 calendar days ending today, keeping the days with an HRV reading, and at least five of them. The mean of the older half is compared with the mean of the newer half, and a move under 2% reads as steady. A steady window still reads as falling when the last two readings are on consecutive days, the second is lower, and it sits below the window mean.
methodology.periodComparisonRestDay: Compares last week against your 4-week average when the current week has no activities yet.
methodology.ftpEstimation: Compares your latest daily eFTP with the value from 30 days earlier. eFTP is intervals.icu's estimate from your power curve, not the FTP setting on your account.
methodology.criticalSpeedDescription: Compares your latest critical speed from the 42-day pace curve with the most recent earlier value that differs from it by more than 0.02 m/s within the previous 90 days, and shows the change as pace.
methodology.efficiencyDescription: Tracks average heart rate multiplied by pace across matched efforts on the section, with an ordinary least squares regression over time. A falling value means fewer beats for the same pace.
methodology.efficiencyFormula: efficiency = average heart rate × pace (seconds per km)
methodology.route: Counts attempts on a route in one sport and direction that are timed, not excluded, not partial and inside the route's distance band. A record is the fastest of them, set recently. A trend compares the median of the last three against the three before, from six attempts.

insights.aboutBody: Training metrics are estimates based on published exercise science models. Individual responses vary significantly. These insights are informational only, not medical or coaching advice.
insights.aboutRanking: Cards are ordered by how much each one has to say: how recent it is, how far it stands out from your usual, how much it has moved, and how often you do it.

efficiencyTrend.seriesLabel: Heart rate per unit of pace, oldest effort to newest
efficiencyTrend.title: Efficiency improving on {{name}}
efficiencyTrend.changeSubtitle: Modelled +{{hrChange}} bpm at average pace over {{efforts}} efforts
efficiencyTrend.changeBody: Over {{efforts}} efforts on {{name}}, heart rate times pace increased. At the average pace this is a modelled +{{hrChange}} bpm; measured heart rate may differ.
efficiencyTrend.subtitle: Modelled {{hrChange}} bpm at average pace over {{efforts}} efforts
efficiencyTrend.body: Over {{efforts}} efforts on {{name}}, heart rate times pace has improved. At your average pace that is a modelled {{hrChange}} bpm; your heart rate itself may not have changed.
efficiencyTrend.sheetBody: Based on repeat efforts on the same section that carry both heart rate and pace. Compares what each pass cost your heart over time.
efficiencyTrend.sheetMeta: Open the section for the underlying efforts.

strengthBalance.oneSidedBody: {{dominant}} represents all of the weighted set volume for {{pair}} across the past 4 weeks.
strengthBalance.ratioBody: {{pair}} averages {{ratio}} in weighted sets in the most recent 4-week window.
strengthBalance.algorithm: Compares weighted set counts across common antagonist pairs. Primary work counts as 1.0 and secondary work counts as 0.5.
strengthBalance.methodologyDescription: Compares weighted set counts across antagonist muscle pairs over the last 4 weeks to flag skewed loading patterns.
strengthBalance.ratioFormula: ratio = dominant weighted sets / secondary weighted sets

strengthProgression.shiftBody: {{muscle}} shifted from {{from}} to {{to}} weighted sets in the current 2-week average.
strengthProgression.algorithm: Tracks weighted sets per muscle across the last 4 weeks. Primary work counts as 1.0 and secondary work counts as 0.5.
strengthProgression.methodologyDescription: Compares the recent 2-week average against the earlier 2-week average to detect meaningful changes in weighted set volume.

strengthSnapshot.formula: Counts of strength sessions, sets, and tracked muscle groups
strengthSnapshot.algorithm: Aggregates strength workouts in the last 4 weeks. Primary work counts as 1.0 and secondary work counts as 0.5 toward each muscle group.
strengthSnapshot.methodologyDescription: Summarises strength volume across the most recent 4 weeks: workout count, total sets, and number of tracked muscle groups.

stats.completePowerActivities: Complete power-based activities to see your FTP trend

wellness.smoothingDescription: Apply a rolling average to reduce daily noise and show trends more clearly.
wellness.smoothingHint: Auto uses optimal smoothing for the selected time range
wellness.trendHint: HRV, sleep, and resting HR trends will appear here when data is logged

v022.mapStylesBody: Choose light, dark, or satellite map styles with smart 3D terrain for hilly activities.
v022.mapStylesHint: High-res satellite covers Switzerland and France. Smart 3D activates for activities with 30 m+ gain and 3 m/km+ gradient.
v022.heatmapBody: Your training calendar on the Health page, showing a year of training. Press and hold the wellness chart to highlight that day on the calendar.
v022.heatmapTip: Press and hold on the health metrics to see the values. The activity heatmap updates to match.
v022.fitnessBody: Track your fitness, fatigue, and form with colour-coded zones.

v030.insightsBody: Personalised daily insights based on your training: section PRs, efficiency trends, fitness milestones, and HRV patterns.
v030.strengthBody: Visualise muscle group volume with body diagrams. Track balance between antagonist pairs and monitor progression over time.
v030.sectionTrimBody: Fine-tune section boundaries with a dual-handle slider. Trim to narrow the range, or switch to expand mode to extend beyond the auto-detected limits when detection missed part of the route. Changes are reflected on the map in real time.
v030.backupBody: Back up your settings and decisions in a small file, then share it from your device. Restoring fetches activities again and applies your decisions where they match.

v040.sectionsBody: Sections are deterministic and reshape as your runs add up; pin one to hold it stable.
v040.diffUnchanged: All {{sections}} sections came through the re-analysis unchanged.
v040.recutFailed: The re-analysis did not finish. Your sections are unchanged and it runs again next launch.
v040.recutFailedAfterApply: Your sections were re-analysed, but the summary of what changed was not saved. It is written again next launch.
v040.settingsReset: Your section detection settings were reset to the validated values: {{changes}}. Preview section changes, then Keep, puts the earlier ones back.

strength.epleyMethod: Epley: weight × (1 + reps / 30). No estimate above 10 reps.

strength.noWorkoutsHint: Complete a strength workout to see your muscle group breakdown here

strength.periodOwed_other: {{count}} workouts in this period not downloaded yet
strength.downloadingHint: Your set data arrives with the workout files. This updates when they land.
strength.relativeWeightedSets: Relative weighted sets across the selected period
strength.tapMuscleGroup: Tap a muscle group for details
strength.balanceObservedPairs: Observed across tracked antagonist pairs in the current {{period}}
strength.balancedPairsClose: The tracked pairs sit relatively close together in this period.
strength.balanceDominant: {{dominant}} carries more weighted-set volume than {{other}} in {{pair}}.
strength.balanceFootnote: Ratios compare weighted sets, where primary work counts as 1.0 and secondary work counts as 0.5.
strength.pairsInfoThresholds: Status: balanced ≤ 1.35×, watch up to 2×, imbalanced above 2×.
strength.pairsInfoMinSignal: Pairs with fewer than 4 weighted sets per side are skipped.
strength.infoWeighting: Primary exercises count as 1 set, secondary as 0.5 sets toward each muscle group. Volume is weight × reps. Secondary sets, reps and volume count at half; sets without reps add no volume.
strength.disclaimer: Volume calculations are approximations based on exercise data from your connected device.

strength.exerciseActivitiesEmpty: No workouts with this exercise in this period.
